correctness.rationale: Expanding four Gaussian TT replicas by Isserlis pairings gives exactly three pairing states per mode. Mismatching physical indices constrain the local state; adjacent equal or unequal pairings contribute 1 or 1/r. The 3×3 transfer matrix has eigenvalues 1+2/r and 1-1/r (double), giving the exact product and diagonal moment. Strict decrease and convexity of log((1+2z^g)/3), 0<z<1, produce both sharp extrema; expanding the finite diagonal quadratic form proves the variance statement. Standalone CHECK.py independently brute-expands all four Gaussian bond paths for selected exact cases, plus 22,694 rational test assertions; no computational evidence replaces the all-parameter proof. Boundary cases r=1, k=0, k=1, k=d are separately handled.

value.rationale: Determines the entire coordinatewise fourth-moment kernel for real Gaussian finite-bond-rank TT probes and consequently the exact variance of arbitrary diagonal stochastic trace estimators. Its sharp fixed-mismatch ordering solves a natural mode-layout problem; two positive diagonal matrices with identical trace and eigenvalues yield exact variance 52 versus 99/2 for one sketch merely by different mode placement. This is an exact structural correlation result not subsumed by concentration inequalities or an arbitrary slice.
